text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
—Kris S-san.
What article are you reading?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
“...I was researching how people spend their days off in Japan.
To use as reference for my next holiday.”

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—I want to... experience something...
that feels truly traditional and Japanese.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I see... In that case,
how about trying some zazen meditation?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: It is a time-honored discipline where one clears their mind and looks deep within themselves.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
It may not be a conventional way to spend leisure time...
but it is commonly practiced at temple zazen sessions and the like.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Zazen... I am deeply interested.
I would be honored to try it.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Straighten your posture and close your eyes.
Then, steady your breathing with deep abdominal breaths.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Next after posture and breathing is calming the mind.
Cast aside all distractions and face yourself.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
(............All I can hear...
............is the sound of my own breathing............)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for your hard work, Kris S-san.
How was your zazen meditation?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
...My consciousness and—senses—have sharpened.
It feels as though I have stepped—into a new realm.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps she grasped something through zazen—
from that day on, Symboli Kris S's running
gained a noticeably sharper edge.
